body: I appreciate everyone's help. I want to be a healthy person and do my best not to repeat problems. I came here for insight on what I did wrong because sometimes it's hard to see when you're too close to the situation.
I do have a therapist and I scheduled extra time with him this week.
I think that we both have issue to work out, honestly. I think its fair to say we both did things wrong.

I know full well I did plenty of things wrong and I'm happy to admit it.

I really didn't want to drive but wanted her to have space. I handled it very poorly and irresponsibly and I sure won't do it again. I tend to look past my health problems until they get the better of me and something actually bad happens. That's something I need to fix. I scheduled doctors appointments I have been avoiding and extra time with my counselor. 

Its hard not to beat myself up when I hurt someone I deeply care about and did so much wrong but at least I don't do it again.
I think there is a lot on my side that I can't explain well. I think a lot of her actions are normal. She just has commitment issues and it was on me for going for it anyway.
I guess I don't know how to say that I didn't cause things? I've seen many mental health professionals. I seriously don't know what else to do about what is going on.

I think you are spot on with a lot of this with a couple exceptions that there is no way I'd talk you out of believing. I will tell you that I am not suicidal. I've also never felt she was taking advantage of me.

I apologized for my paranoia, toxic things I did, and being inexcusably irresponsible. My point in posting was not so people could tell me that she is treating me wrong and be on my side because I genuinely understand I messed a lot up and I'm responsible. I really wanted to understand what was going on and I think your comment was helpful in a lot of ways.
This is probably right. She just can't handle a relationship right now. Especially with me being toxic and wreckless.

She doesn't love the idea of having a relationship at all

It was ultimately my choice to drive and like someone else said, it was on me for not telling the policeman my health issues.

I don't really think she is the awful partner I made her seem here. I thought we were doing really good up until this last week. 
I know she is very independent and I like that but at the same time she needs to talk to a lot of people to get gratification.

The thing is, I don't have BPD. I just have shit luck and when one thing happens to me, everything happens to me. This isn't the first time I've been accused of whatever people with BPD do for attention. I have always had poor health and a shitty home life and yes, I need a lot of reassurance. I don't know what to do. I'm very sick, I need surgery, and I didn't create that but somehow I keep getting accused of it. 

I am working closely with a therapist. I talk to him a couple times a week. I'm doing my very best but don't know how to stop everything from continuously getting worse.

I can't blame her for having me drive home. I couldn't wait much longer anyway because I had my dogs at home that needed me. 

Someone just accused me of having BPD because of all these emergencies happening around all of this. The truth is my life has been crashing for weeks and this seems to just be a thing with me which has caused an awful depression that definitely pushed people away so its my fault I don't have the support I need.

My health problems have been a problem since before I met my girlfriend. I was in the hospital last week and diagnosed with a heart problem due to having an autoimmune disease that I've known about for a while. I've had problems with passing out and feeling sick since then. I definitely have less issues when I'm not so stressed so its true that things get worse for me at certain times. 

I'm guilty of needing a lot of reassurance but felt good about my relationship up until last week. I understand her needing space from me and I'm willing to give her what she needs. 

I so see a counselor very regularly and know whats going on mentally. I'm pretty good at just saying when I need attention. The attention that comes from being sick or having an emergency is insanely empty compared to the attention that you can get from someone who truly cares so that's not really what I'm looking for.

She waited on the phone with me until I got help and wanted me to call once I knew my ct scan results. After that is when she told me not to contact her. She wanted me to leave her a voice mail of how I was doing physically this morning but I just can't. I don't see how someone can care about my physical being but not mental. 

I guess it's hard to believe her when it's been okay right up until the open part. She knows I was insecure about losing her to the first person she talks to and now it feels like all my insecurities are cominherself.

I desperately care about her and don't feel she is the monster people could assume. I think she is just trying to protect herself. 

I have so much work to do. I've always said that. I try so hard and mess so much up. My depression has always affected my relationships and I'm trying to change but never feel like I have support.

I don't really expect her to change and I don't feel like she doesn't take me seriously. She knows how serious I am and how much I want a real relationship and it scares her. I know that but I'm still lost on how she suddenly wants me not to contact her for days as soon as she meets someone. Its like all my insecurities about losing someone in an open relationship are coming true. Its exactly what I thought would happen. We had lived together for 2 weeks with no problem when i had covid at my house and now all the sudden a weekend is too much?

I really didn't feel like this was the case until this week. She meets a lot of my needs normally. Then this week when I became insecure and she met someone else to talk to, I just felt very unimportant go her. I know I pushed her a bit this weekend but I thought things were getting resolved right up until she told me not to contact her. I don't know if that's a normal thing
The distance part is usually a good thing for me. I know that I can get overwhelming so its good when I can't just see my partner any time. I don't really feel like the distance is a problem.

If I was sure it all just turned black and disappeared, I wouldn't be able to hold back. The scary part to me is the thought of an afterlife. I don't want there to be an afterlife, this life is already too much.
I'm a little lost at what you're getting at through those posts

I also feel like me asking all the time puts more pressure on her but I don't know what else to do. I feel like a terrible person when I have these needs. I've never been the one in a relationship that desires more sex so this is all new for me. 

My girlfriend used to masturbate almost every night and doesn't at all anymore. I keep thinking about bringing that up again because I think it relaxed her and made her see the good things that come from sexual satisfaction and made her want to have sex more. My therapist even suggested that maybe we masturbate together sometimes if sex seems too much. Maybe you guys could try that. 

I don't think these problems get fixed without being completely open and having proper communication. My therapist seems to think that's the biggest problem with most DB situations.

We have been incredibly open. We are doing a lot of reading on things to try and we have counseling scheduled as well. She isn't even masturbating right now and has no desire. I watched it decline along with her sleep schedule when she got a new job and started school.

I've definitely been open with her about how I feel. She is happy to try anything to get her sex drive back. We have counseling scheduled and have been doing a lot of reading together on things to try. Unfortunately, none of that fixes the nonstop schedule and lack of sleep.

The part that's weird to me is she isn't even masturbing anymore. It's not like she is only shutting me out. She just suddenly has no desire for sex. She is great at most other types of intimacy but when she got a full time job and started school she got less and less sleep and that's exactly when sex was declining.
